LightningComponentBundle.description: Tabular assortment view with sortable columns, grouping, size run drill-down, buyer approval workflow, and CSV export.

property.name: buyerMode
property.label: Buyer mode (read-only)
property.description: Set to true to render the read-only buyer portal view. Sales reps use false (default).

property.name: maxDoors
property.label: Max doors in account network
property.description: Used to scale the door distribution progress bar. Defaults to 12.
